input_encoding: Little-endian uint32 count, then 12 words per case: signed int32 width,height,row,column; uint32 terrain,overlay,centerRoad,north,south,west,east,poisonByte.
original_output_encoding: 600 signed little-endian int32 returns in input record order

measurement.method: The native i386 adapter fills an arena with each poison byte, sets gameData to arena+4096, writes only the supplied descriptor fields, and invokes unchanged original entry 0x424120. Arena and gameData page are read-only during every call; there are no callees or substituted behaviors.

boundary_encoding: width uint32,height uint32,row int32,column int32,readable dimension pages,null gameData; width occupies the last DWORD of page34, height begins page35, and all tile pages are inaccessible
boundary_evidence: Expected zero returns and skipped accesses are assembly-backed by the ordered guards at 0x424120 and return path 0x424338. These 13 protected-page cases are separate from the 600 measured result records above; the measured records also include ordinary zero-dimension and unsigned-wrap border cases.
limits: Public files contain no original instructions or new retail data. This compact original-measured set covers the reached predicate and successful boundary guards, not every combination, arbitrary invalid pointers, general coordinate overflow, rendering, or route completion. The private full-domain original oracle is retained separately.
